title: Classic Lightroom-style theme and selectable editor canvas surrounds
source: rapidroom (original implementation; neutral palette values inspired by LightCraft, MIT/Apache-2.0)
notes: Adds an opt-in Classic theme with neutral dark chrome and blue accent, while retaining Dark, Light and Grey unchanged. Temperature, tint and HSL coloured tracks remain available. Editor surrounds can be theme, black, dark grey, mid grey or white; the old neutral-grey preference maps to mid grey. No photo processing or exported pixels change.
highlight: Classic adds a compact Lightroom-like dark workspace with a blue accent and selectable editor surrounds.
